The point of impact becomes covered with lava temporarily, inflicting constant fire damage on enemies in it. | ## Details [![](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/images/c/ce/Meteor_Strike_Meteor.png)](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Meteor_Strike_Meteor.png) [Enlarge](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Meteor_Strike_Meteor.png "Enlarge") The Meteor, moments before colliding the ground. [![](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/images/7/75/Meteor_Strike_Fire.png)](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Meteor_Strike_Fire.png) [Enlarge](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Meteor_Strike_Fire.png "Enlarge") Fire leftover from impact. [![](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/images/6/6e/Meteor_Strike_Start-Up.png)](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Meteor_Strike_Start-Up.png) [Enlarge](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/File:Meteor_Strike_Start-Up.png "Enlarge") Meteor Strike on start-up. - Requires a [Staff](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Staves_List "Staves List") to use. - Summons a large meteor over a designated area, creating an explosion as it crashes into the ground. The meteor leaves flames in its wake, damaging enemies that walk over it. - Enemies can run out of the fire to avoid damage so long as they stay out of it. - Meteor Strike requires a targetable enemy in order to use. - Meteor Strike can be cast over [props](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Props "Props") and physical obstacles. - An exception is [Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Rabbie_Phantasm_Dungeon "Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon") and [Crom Bas](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Crom_Bas "Crom Bas"), which blocks players from casting it through walls and cages. - When casting, a magical circle will appear beneath the user. When it is done loading, a red targeting circle will appear on the ground beneath the mouse cursor, allowing the user to designate the location. - To target a specific monster directly, simply Left Alt + Left Click or use Ctrl Targeting and target the desired monster. - Doing so will aim for the center of its hitbox in its last position. - After launching the spell, the sky will temporarily become cloudy until the meteor lands. A white flash will also occur when the meteor lands, affecting every player within the area regardless of their distance from the meteor. - The skill will continue to drain the user's [mana](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Mana "Mana") after loading until the meteor has been launched. - Ignores [Magic Protection](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Magic_Protection "Magic Protection") when calculating critical rate. - The skill damages enemies through 2 means: 1. Physical and magical damage through the impact. - Both the physical and magical damage through impact are calculated and displayed as one value. - Impact damage ignores [Heavy Stander](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Heavy_Stander "Heavy Stander") and [Mana Deflector](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Mana_Deflector "Mana Deflector"), but not [Invulnerability](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Invulnerability "Invulnerability"). - Impact damage is affected by [Magic Attack](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Magic_Attack "Magic Attack"). 2. Ranged damage through the fire. - Residual damage can lower a target's HP past 0 and can kill. - Like other damage over time effects, residual damage bypasses Invulnerability. - Residual damage is affected by the target's [Natural Shield](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Natural_Shield_(Monster) "Natural Shield (Monster)"). - Residual damage is based on the skill's rank and cannot be increased. - Residual damage cannot score [criticals](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Critical "Critical"). - The flames linger around for 10 seconds, dealing damage every 2 seconds for a total of 5 ticks. - Base Casting Time is 2 seconds. Meteor Strike will land once cast after 2 seconds. - Non-player Meteor Strikes have a Casting Time of 4 seconds and Travel Time of 5 seconds instead. - Can not be used while [Rafting](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Rafting "Rafting") or [Hot-Air Ballooning](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Hot-Air_Ballooning "Hot-Air Ballooning"). - Enabling [Mini Effects](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Options_Dialog#Performance "Options Dialog") causes the casting effects, the meteor, the explosion, and the leftover flames to become invisible. - Rank 1 Meteor Strike is required to use the Time Shift [Technique](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Technique "Technique"). ## Summary | Rank | N | F | E | D | C | B | A | 9 | 8 | 7 | 6 | 5 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Required AP | - (Only for the initial cast) ## Obtaining the Skill - Create or [rebirth](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Rebirth "Rebirth") a character and select the [Druid Talent](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Talent#Hero_Talents "Talent") to be the active talent. - Requires 39 [Pon](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Pon "Pon") Or, - Complete the \[Ultimate Fire\] quest. | How to Get Quest | Acquire Rank 1 [Fireball](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Fireball "Fireball") and [Fire Mastery](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Fire_Mastery "Fire Mastery"). | | Briefing | Those who comprehend the true nature of fire can summon a powerful Fire Crystal from across time and space. According to the Druidic records, you need many Fire Elementals to explore this magic. If you bring me some Fire Elementals, I will tell you what your next step is. - Stewart | | Objectives | - Deliver 20 [Fire Elementals](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Fire_Elemental "Fire Elemental") to [Stewart](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Stewart "Stewart")
- Attack a [Fire Sprite](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Fire_Sprite "Fire Sprite") with [Firebolt](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Firebolt "Firebolt") 100 times.
- Attack a [Balrog](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Balrog "Balrog") with Firebolt 100 times.
- Attack a [Dragon](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dragon "Dragon") with Firebolt 100 times.
- Defeat 1 [Red Dragon](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Red_Dragon "Red Dragon") | | Rewards | - 100,000 Experience Points

- Using Firebolt against any dragon present in [The Saga: Iria](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/The_Saga:_Iria "The Saga: Iria") will not count for the quest.
- [Enslaved Crumena](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Enslaved_Crumena "Enslaved Crumena") in [The Saga: Iria II](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/The_Saga:_Iria_II "The Saga: Iria II")'s [Crumena on the Rampage](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Crumena_on_the_Rampage "Crumena on the Rampage") will count toward 'defeat 1 Red Dragon' but not toward 'attack a dragon with Firebolt'.
- For the [Red Dragon](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Red_Dragon "Red Dragon") objective, the player must land the finishing blow in order for it to count. The finish is awarded based on total number of hits, not total damage dealt. | ## Training Method ### Tips - For early ranks, you can easily group monsters with [Act 6: Crisis](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Act_6:_Crisis "Act 6: Crisis") and then cast Meteor Strike, effectively training multiple enemy hits. This is best done in a party with the finish rule set to Anyone. - Another player may be required to assist with this method. - Having another player use [Enthralling Performance](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Enthralling_Performance "Enthralling Performance") will allow multiple monsters group up in a single area, allowing for easier training with multiple hits. - Getting a [Giant](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Giant "Giant") player use [Taunt](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Taunt "Taunt") and [Wind Guard](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Wind_Guard "Wind Guard") to group many monsters around them, letting you hit them all with Meteor easily. - Areas of interest for large amount of spawns may include: - [Brown Foxes](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Brown_Fox "Brown Fox") at northern [Tir Chonaill](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Tir_Chonaill "Tir Chonaill"), on the way to Alby Dungeon. - The lobby area and the middle rooms of [Sulfur Spiders of the Shadow Realm](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Sulfur_Spiders_of_the_Shadow_Realm "Sulfur Spiders of the Shadow Realm"). - Summoning area of effect summon [pets](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Pets "Pets") and/or using [Lullaby](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Lullaby "Lullaby") beforehand will help keep the spiders in place as the player casts Meteor Strike. - [The Other Alchemists](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/The_Other_Alchemists "The Other Alchemists")' middle room. - [Fennec Foxes](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Fennec_Fox "Fennec Fox") outside [Filia](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Filia "Filia")'s southeastern Outskirts. - [Their Method](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Their_Method "Their Method")'s boss room (Will not work for getting more than 12 mobs hit at once) - However, it is possible to create [Barrier Spikes](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Barrier_Spikes "Barrier Spikes") in order to fulfill the condition, granted the player has high enough a rank. - [Raccoons](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Raccoon "Raccoon") north of the Logging Camp in [Dugald Aisle](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dugald_Aisle "Dugald Aisle"). - [Shyllien Nature Reserve](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Shyllien_Nature_Reserve "Shyllien Nature Reserve") Outskirts 2 in front of the giant crystal deposit. - [Hillwen Mine](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Hillwen_Mine "Hillwen Mine")B3 in front of the giant ore deposit. - Keep in mind that in both the Hillwen Mine and Shyllien Nature Reserve have extremely powerful mobs and may overwhelm you if precautions are not taken. - [Polar Hornets](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Polar_Hornet "Polar Hornet") in Silva Forest, south of [Vales](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Vales "Vales"). - [Flame Burst](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Flame_Burst "Flame Burst") works well to lock the hornets' aggro and gather a large number into one location. - [Offering](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Offering "Offering") - Beware that after the 3rd wave spawns the mission will automatically fail on next spawn. - For damage requirements, it may require targeting multiple weaker monsters at once while simultaneously landing a critical hit. ### Novice Rank - Description

 A powerful magic spell that summons a huge meteor from the sky, turning a vast area into a blazing inferno. The point of impact becomes covered with lava temporarily, inflicting constant fire damage on enemies in it.

Details

The Meteor, moments before colliding the ground.
Fire leftover from impact.
Meteor Strike on start-up.
  • Requires a Staff to use.
  • Summons a large meteor over a designated area, creating an explosion as it crashes into the ground. The meteor leaves flames in its wake, damaging enemies that walk over it.
    • Enemies can run out of the fire to avoid damage so long as they stay out of it.
    • Meteor Strike requires a targetable enemy in order to use.
    • Meteor Strike can be cast over props and physical obstacles.
      • An exception is Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon and Crom Bas, which blocks players from casting it through walls and cages.
  • When casting, a magical circle will appear beneath the user. When it is done loading, a red targeting circle will appear on the ground beneath the mouse cursor, allowing the user to designate the location.
    • To target a specific monster directly, simply Left Alt + Left Click or use Ctrl Targeting and target the desired monster.
      • Doing so will aim for the center of its hitbox in its last position.
  • After launching the spell, the sky will temporarily become cloudy until the meteor lands. A white flash will also occur when the meteor lands, affecting every player within the area regardless of their distance from the meteor.
  • The skill will continue to drain the user's mana after loading until the meteor has been launched.
  • Ignores Magic Protection when calculating critical rate.
  • The skill damages enemies through 2 means:
    1. Physical and magical damage through the impact.
      • Both the physical and magical damage through impact are calculated and displayed as one value.
      • Impact damage ignores Heavy Stander and Mana Deflector, but not Invulnerability.
      • Impact damage is affected by Magic Attack.
    2. Ranged damage through the fire.
      • Residual damage can lower a target's HP past 0 and can kill.
      • Like other damage over time effects, residual damage bypasses Invulnerability.
      • Residual damage is affected by the target's Natural Shield.
      • Residual damage is based on the skill's rank and cannot be increased.
      • Residual damage cannot score criticals.
      • The flames linger around for 10 seconds, dealing damage every 2 seconds for a total of 5 ticks.
  • Base Casting Time is 2 seconds. Meteor Strike will land once cast after 2 seconds.
    • Non-player Meteor Strikes have a Casting Time of 4 seconds and Travel Time of 5 seconds instead.
  • Can not be used while Rafting or Hot-Air Ballooning.
  • Enabling Mini Effects causes the casting effects, the meteor, the explosion, and the leftover flames to become invisible.
  • Rank 1 Meteor Strike is required to use the Time Shift Technique.

Obtaining the Skill

  • Create or rebirth a character and select the Druid Talent to be the active talent.
    • Requires 39 Pon

Or,

  • Complete the [Ultimate Fire] quest.
How to Get Quest

Acquire Rank 1 Fireball and Fire Mastery.

Briefing Those who comprehend the true nature of fire can summon a powerful Fire Crystal from across time and space. According to the Druidic records, you need many Fire Elementals to explore this magic. If you bring me some Fire Elementals, I will tell you what your next step is. - Stewart
Objectives
  • Deliver 20 Fire Elementals to Stewart
  • Attack a Fire Sprite with Firebolt 100 times.
  • Attack a Balrog with Firebolt 100 times.
  • Attack a Dragon with Firebolt 100 times.
  • Defeat 1 Red Dragon
Rewards
  • 100,000 Experience Points
  • Obtain the [Meteor Strike] skill.
Additional Information
  • Fire Elementals can easily be obtained by harvesting it from Fire Sprites; right-click it with a Fire-type Wand equipped and no left-hand item, and select "Gather".
  • Using Firebolt against any dragon present in The Saga: Iria will not count for the quest.
  • Enslaved Crumena in The Saga: Iria II's Crumena on the Rampage will count toward 'defeat 1 Red Dragon' but not toward 'attack a dragon with Firebolt'.
  • For the Red Dragon objective, the player must land the finishing blow in order for it to count. The finish is awarded based on total number of hits, not total damage dealt.

Training Method

Tips

  • For early ranks, you can easily group monsters with Act 6: Crisis and then cast Meteor Strike, effectively training multiple enemy hits. This is best done in a party with the finish rule set to Anyone.
    • Another player may be required to assist with this method.
  • Having another player use Enthralling Performance will allow multiple monsters group up in a single area, allowing for easier training with multiple hits.
  • Getting a Giant player use Taunt and Wind Guard to group many monsters around them, letting you hit them all with Meteor easily.
  • Areas of interest for large amount of spawns may include:
    • Brown Foxes at northern Tir Chonaill, on the way to Alby Dungeon.
    • The lobby area and the middle rooms of Sulfur Spiders of the Shadow Realm.
      • Summoning area of effect summon pets and/or using Lullaby beforehand will help keep the spiders in place as the player casts Meteor Strike.
    • The Other Alchemists' middle room.
    • Fennec Foxes outside Filia's southeastern Outskirts.
    • Their Method's boss room (Will not work for getting more than 12 mobs hit at once)
      • However, it is possible to create Barrier Spikes in order to fulfill the condition, granted the player has high enough a rank.
    • Raccoons north of the Logging Camp in Dugald Aisle.
    • Shyllien Nature Reserve Outskirts 2 in front of the giant crystal deposit.
    • Hillwen Mine B3 in front of the giant ore deposit.
      • Keep in mind that in both the Hillwen Mine and Shyllien Nature Reserve have extremely powerful mobs and may overwhelm you if precautions are not taken.
    • Polar Hornets in Silva Forest, south of Vales.
      • Flame Burst works well to lock the hornets' aggro and gather a large number into one location.
    • Offering
      • Beware that after the 3rd wave spawns the mission will automatically fail on next spawn.
  • For damage requirements, it may require targeting multiple weaker monsters at once while simultaneously landing a critical hit.

Trivia

  • Using Meteor Strike with the Halloween Party Prefix Title changes the meteor's appearance into a giant Trick Pumpkin.
  • Meteor Strike requires the most AP out of all skills within the game; 31 more than Crash Shot.
  • Meteor Strike's base cooldown used to be 30 minutes, until it was shortened to 15 minutes with the Renovation Patch in 2015.
    • The Demolition Deepglow and Lord of Ruination Staves' effects further decrease the cooldown of Meteor Strike by 250 seconds and 400 seconds respectively. This makes shortest possible cooldown for Meteor Strike 8 minutes and 20 seconds (500 seconds) if one doesn't count Time Shift and Bachram Boost.
